title: Native CLM v0 M3L-2 — Online Historical Address-State Integration
scientific_question: Starting from the exact canonical M1 checkpoint, can a persistent rank-32 historical query address state and lineage-local affine gate convert the M3L-1 checkpoint-level addressability result into replay-free continual-language retention beyond the matched M3R lineage-cosine algorithm?
new_integration_variable: persistent online rank-32 historical query address state plus affine parent-child gate; protected writes, root routing, growth pressure thresholds, stream and training schedule remain matched to M3R

bootstrap.timing: before continual phase B and before either causal arm performs any learner update
bootstrap.role: construct rank-32 historical query address sidecar for the original eight M1 roots
bootstrap.disclosure: This is an explicitly registered bootstrap because the historical M1 checkpoint predates query-address sidecars; it is not claimed to be endogenous M1 state.

causal_arms.lineage_cosine_control: exact M3R immutable-root lineage chain with frozen parent/child cosine-key decision
causal_arms.online_address_state: same protected-write/growth algorithm, but each lineage leaf persistently maintains a bounded rank-32 query sketch and each parent-child edge routes through an affine gate derived from historical parent state versus the current conflict window

address_state.representation: count + mean + top-rank covariance eigenvectors/eigenvalues + residual diagonal variance
address_state.online_update: merge current routed query moments into the active leaf sketch, recompute and truncate to rank 32
address_state.gate: regularized pooled low-rank Gaussian LDA affine boundary w^T q + b > threshold
address_state.birth: child operator is an exact parent clone; parent historical sketch is frozen; child sketch is initialized from the conflict window; affine edge gate is installed after birth
address_state.root_router: frozen M1 query projection and original eight route keys only

growth.note: Numerical pressure-controller thresholds are copied unchanged from frozen M3/M3R.

formal_decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every formal seed completes and every registered gate is true on every seed
next_if_supported: close the local functional-address blocker, then proceed to M4 Cell ontology/specialization at the same model scale before any 30M scaling
next_if_not_supported: freeze M3L-2 negative and diagnose online-state lifecycle/gate ownership without tuning or reusing formal seeds
